name: sweet-couple-lifestyle-photography
image_purpose: approved couple identity and lifestyle reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic lifestyle portrait of two approved adults using the supplied local image as the required identity reference for both people.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with dark brown hair and approved adult man with short dark hair and light beard; preserve each supplied identity separately without mixing faces.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium eye-level portrait, couple standing close with a light embrace and natural smiles, softly blurred balcony or cozy city setting, warm decorative lights, realistic clothing and proportions.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm natural golden-hour or evening light, romantic candid mood without sexualized posing.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic lifestyle photography, portrait 4:5, faces sharp, background gently blurred, realistic skin texture and warm tones.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic portrait of two approved adults, preserving each supplied face separately and accurately. The dark-haired woman and short-haired bearded man stand close with a light embrace and genuine smiles in a softly blurred warm city or balcony setting with golden-hour decorative lights. Keep the mood affectionate, candid, and non-sexualized.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, transparent clothing, face mixing, identity drift, distorted hands, extra limbs, plastic skin, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.

assets.name: sweet-couple-lifestyle-photography_0.jpg

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required local image. Preserve the two identities separately, their hair, clothing, pose, lighting, and environment; replaceability applies to either identity only with a separately approved reference. Do not mix faces or invent typography/logos.
